title: Absolutely continuous Laplace spectrum on negatively curved Hadamard manifolds asymptotically harmonic at one ideal point
author: Werner Ballmann; Mayukh Mukherjee; Panagiotis Polymerakis
source_title: On the Spectrum of Certain Hadamard Manifolds
difficulty_reason: The proof uses a Busemann vector field to derive a positive commutator estimate controlling derivatives tangent to horospheres. It converts this into local smoothness for the resolvent and excludes every singular spectral component through distributional constancy along infinite-volume horospheres. For the pinched-curvature case it builds cutoff pullbacks of one-dimensional approximate eigenfunctions, proving the entire half-line is present in the spectrum.
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 050, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.050; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The full Theorem1.2 has negative sectional curvature and the Hadamard completeness/simply-connected setting, with constant horosphere mean curvature h>0 at one fixed ideal point. The stronger equality sigma=[h^2/4,infinity) additionally assumes negative pinching and bounded covariant derivative of curvature. Include Observation2.1, the Rellich identity and Section4 smoothness/core argument, plus Section6 cutoff/Weyl construction; the latter treats M as the trivial-group quotient. Resolvent smoothness criteria and the published geometric cutoff-Laplacian estimate [5,Section6] are explicitly established background, not missing newly claimed lemmas. The source provides the new estimate application and exact norm/error calculation. Domain and nontrivial-quotient variants are not separate counted claims.
